primary_family.description: The primary font family name used for aliasing and locale overrides.

secondary_family.description: The secondary font family name (e.g., Light variant) used for aliasing and locale overrides.

locale_code.description: The locale code (language tag) to match for font fallback overrides.

primary_family_no_trailing_space.description: The primary font family name as it appears in the scan match edit, preserving specific spacing if required.

secondary_style.description: The style name for the secondary family used in the scan match edit.

weight_value.description: The font weight value (integer) for the secondary family.
